All done. Here's a summary of the changes:

1. **`pipeline/steps.py`** — Added a `Truncate(Step)` class that takes a `length` in its constructor and slices text with `text[:length]`.
2. **`pipeline/registry.py`** — Modified `lookup()` to split names on the first colon. For `"truncate:N"`, it parses `N` as an integer and returns a new `Truncate(N)`. Missing or non-integer arguments raise `ValueError`. The bare name `"truncate"` (no colon, not in `STEPS`) also raises `ValueError` instead of the usual `KeyError`.
3. **`tests/test_pipeline.py`** — Added 7 tests covering all specified cases: basic truncation, past-end no-op, zero-length, missing length, non-numeric argument, bare name, and chaining with `strip`.
